title: JANUS Engine R2C — externally precharged startup battery, transient buffer and surplus-energy accumulator
purpose: Give JANUS a physically honest startup-energy reservoir and transient buffer: charge externally before first start, power auxiliaries while the gill/PEMFC and optional VRU/AKS subsystems converge, then recharge from measured surplus after self-drive is reached.

energy_sources_and_sinks: PEMFC or later central core after flux lock
optional user/export load only after reserve conditions are satisfied
architecture.important_boundary: The battery is storage, not a primary energy source. Energy charged externally must never be counted as generated JANUS energy.

state_machine.criterion: startup SoC target reached from external source
battery powers prime, pO2 drawdown, pumps, fan and controls while the membrane/core are not yet self-supporting
PEMFC/core increasingly carries auxiliaries while battery fills transient deficits
external input is zero and the battery energy state is non-decreasing over a declared stabilized observation window while all active auxiliaries are supplied
measured generation exceeds auxiliaries and reserve SoC is restored
reserve SoC is satisfied; only then may persistent surplus be exported to useful load
battery retains enough energy for valves, logging, purge/condensate management and controlled stop if generation collapses

energy_accounting.bus_balance: P_net_bus = P_core + P_battery_discharge - P_aux - P_user_load - P_battery_charge
energy_accounting.battery_energy_update: dE_bat/dt = eta_charge * max(P_core - P_aux - P_user_load, 0) - max(P_aux + P_user_load - P_core, 0) / eta_discharge
energy_accounting.self_drive_definition: After STARTUP and LOAD_TRANSFER, with external charger disconnected, average useful generation must cover auxiliaries and battery SoC must not exhibit a continuing downward trend over the declared hold interval.
energy_accounting.anti_self_deception_rule: A run that merely drains a previously externally charged battery is STARTUP_SUPPORTED, not SELF_DRIVE.

mode_A_screening_capacity.basis: RUN-005 indicated that direct-gill/PEMFC gradient establishment can range from tens of minutes to hours depending on oxygen consumption and transport. The first demonstrator targets single-digit to low-tens-of-watts auxiliaries.
mode_A_screening_capacity.screening_conclusion: A roughly 50-100 Wh class buffer is a plausible laboratory screening envelope for the first low-power Mode A demonstrator, but final capacity must be selected only after measured startup duration, bus voltage, peak current, battery temperature and reserve requirements are known.
mode_A_screening_capacity.boundary: This is not a final battery specification and no cell chemistry is frozen here.

mode_B_long_start_boundary.principle: For the integrated VRU/AKS mode, startup may be much longer because sorbent and thermal inventories must stabilize. Capacity scales directly with measured startup deficit and time: E_Wh approximately equals average deficit_W times startup_hours before efficiency/reserve margins.
mode_B_long_start_boundary.legacy_context: Historical one-to-four-day startup experience is retained only as a plant-specific reference and must not be assigned to JANUS before measurement.
mode_B_long_start_boundary.design_consequence: Do not size the Mode B battery by analogy alone; first reduce startup parasitics and identify which loads genuinely need continuous support.

priority_order: only then export persistent surplus to external load
surplus_capture_logic.reason: This prevents a momentary positive-power spike from being mistaken for sustained net generation and gives the machine restart/shutdown resilience.

transient_control.battery: hours/minutes-scale energy buffer and startup reservoir
transient_control.optional_supercapacitor: future seconds/sub-seconds transient buffer if pump/fan/valve current spikes prove material; not required until measured
transient_control.fuel_cell_precedent: Published PEMFC hybrid generators commonly use a battery on a bidirectional power-conditioning bus to absorb/supply transient power while the fuel cell carries the slower average load.

required_logs: battery charge/discharge W and cumulative Wh

three_verdicts.STARTUP_SUPPORTED: system runs while battery energy is declining
three_verdicts.BATTERY_NEUTRAL_SELF_DRIVE: after stabilization external input is zero and battery SoC is stable over the hold window while auxiliaries are supplied
three_verdicts.SURPLUS_GENERATION: battery target SoC is maintained/restored and persistent additional energy is available to an external load

literature_anchors.reference: International Journal of Hydrogen Energy 38 (2013) 3727-3740, DOI 10.1016/j.ijhydene.2013.01.085
literature_anchors.finding: experimental PEM fuel-cell generator hybridized with lithium-ion battery and bidirectional power conditioning to manage fast load dynamics

literature_anchors.reference: Energy Conversion and Management: X (2025) fuel-cell hybrid energy management study
literature_anchors.finding: battery/supercapacitor buffers handle transients and regenerative/surplus energy while fuel cell carries average power

literature_anchors.reference: Fuel Cells 2026 modular yacht hybrid validation, DOI 10.1002/fuce.70147
literature_anchors.finding: battery buffering experimentally stabilizes fuel-cell power systems under dynamic loads and can absorb surplus transient power

next_gate: R2C1_STARTUP_ENERGY_TRACE: instrument one small Mode A loop and record P_deficit(t), E_battery(t), J_O2(t) and pO2(t) from PRIME through SELF_DRIVE_HOLD; use the integral of measured deficit plus declared reserve to freeze the first battery capacity.
